user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Elven Treehouse Village. A village built into colossal trees: curved wooden platforms hugging the trunks, spiral staircases winding up the bark, arched rope bridges between canopies, glowing lanterns hung on branches, leaf-roofed huts with round windows, luminous blue leaves scattered among green, hanging vines, and soft god-rays through the high canopy. Style: elegant nature fantasy. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
